params.prompt:
ONE UNBROKEN CONTINUOUS SHOT, first frame to last: a single take with no cuts. One smooth gimbal camera keeps the airplane in view. Photorealistic live action, 16:9.
The airplane is the plain white dart from the airplane reference: crisply, completely folded from blank A4 (no print, no logo), long sharp nose, two flat identical swept-back wings, sharp creases, neat keel, never crumpled or half-folded. It flies nose first on one smooth continuous path, never jumps, flips or reverses, turns only in slow gentle curves, and never changes shape or size.
Sunny late morning, same warm sunlight direction throughout, no flicker.
Corridor = corridor reference, ONE single straight corridor whose design and exposure never change, the same through the door and inside: glossy light-grey floor with sunlight stripes, tall windows facing the sports field on one side, ivory wall with doors on the other, evenly lit, never blown-out white.
Festival ground = the two festival references, identical layout: a natural green GRASS soccer pitch with striped mowing and white lines inside a red running track; at the FAR end the festival stage with a white truss roof and white tents on both sides; four blocks of black chairs in front of the stage; a small black sound booth in the centre circle; long rows of white booth tents along both sides of the track; the green inflatable air arch standing at the track gate on the NEAR curve, not on the grass; outside the track, nearest the school, the paved lot with six colourful food trucks, white tents and yellow parasol tables; a bus and trucks on the road; red, green and orange bean bags on the lawn to the right; green trees and apartment blocks behind. The festival is busy and joyful: hundreds of students fill the ground, browsing and chatting at the booth tents, queuing and eating at the food trucks and parasol tables, lounging and laughing on the bean bags, posing for photos at the air arch, sitting together in the chair blocks and walking around in small groups; always small, seen from above or behind, no recognisable faces.
Continue the reference video seamlessly from its very last frame as the SAME continuous shot: the first frame keeps the same camera position, the same airplane position and heading, the same location and the same light as the last frame of the reference video.
START STATE: Seen from about two metres behind at chest height, the crisply folded white airplane glides nose first down the middle of the long sunlit corridor: glossy light-grey floor with sunlight stripes, ivory wall with wooden doors on the LEFT, a row of tall windows on the RIGHT.
The whole flight below is ONE unbroken take in this exact order, with natural, unhurried pacing and no fixed timing; each stage flows smoothly into the next with no cut:
1. Continuing the reference video without any cut, the camera keeps following steadily from behind as the airplane glides on along the corridor at chest-to-eye height; through the tall windows on the right the green grass festival ground is visible below, exactly as in the corridor reference.
2. The airplane curves very gently to the RIGHT toward one open side window in that row, not toward the window at the far end of the corridor, and flies out sideways through it into bright open air at third-floor height; the camera follows it through the window frame.
3. The festival ground opens up just below, exactly like the third-floor festival reference: the busy food-truck lot right underneath, the green air arch at the track gate, the grass pitch and the stage at the far end. Riding the breeze, the airplane glides smoothly and gradually DOWN to second-floor height, about six metres above the ground, just above the tops of the booth tents; never a sudden drop. After leaving the window the airplane only glides DOWNWARD and never climbs again until the very end over the stage; it never flies higher than the third-floor window it came out of. The camera stays close, about two metres behind the airplane, and never pulls up into a high aerial or drone view.
4. At that low second-floor height the airplane flies one lap around the festival ground: first along the LEFT long side of the red track, over the row of white booth tents crowded with students, toward the stage at the far end.
5. It curves slowly around the far end, passing in front of the grey terraces and beside the stage, then flies back along the RIGHT long side of the track over the other row of booth tents toward the school, gradually descending a little more.
6. Back at the near end it curves gently around the near-right corner of the track and heads LEFT along the road toward the food-truck lot, now just a few metres above the students' heads.
FINAL FRAME: Seen from about two metres behind and slightly above, the airplane glides a few metres above head height along the road toward the busy food-truck lot with its colourful trucks and yellow parasol tables, the green air arch on the right of frame.
Audio: diegetic only: soft corridor reverb, open-air wind as it leaves the window, a lively festival ambience below (many voices chatting, gentle laughter, footsteps), paper flutter.
Negative: no cuts or scene changes, no jump in time, no teleporting, reversing or tail-first airplane, no airplane shape change, no extra airplanes, no text, subtitles, watermarks or logos, no flicker, no change of location design, no music, no dirt field, no soccer match, no high aerial drone view, no airplane climbing after the window, no people indoors, no close-up or recognisable faces, no raised hands or cheering, no airplane skimming the ground, no flying to the far end of the corridor, no change of the festival layout, no air arch on the grass, no fireworks, no stage performance.
